recipes.about:
See the lowest reported pump prices near you, from the UK government's official Fuel Finder service. Enter a UK postcode, a search radius and a fuel grade: the screen ranks the three lowest reported prices within that straight-line radius, shows ties honestly, and adds the nearest reporting forecourt for context, together with the time the prices were last synced.

Prices are the pump prices forecourts report before any discounts or loyalty offers. Distances are straight-line, not driving distances. The plugin does not show whether a forecourt is open or has fuel in stock, and it does not estimate savings. Forecourts that do not report to Fuel Finder are not shown, and a forecourt whose reported location is more than 5 miles from its own postcode is placed at its postcode. If prices have not been updated for more than 30 minutes the screen says so instead of showing a leaderboard.

Spotted a wrong price? Report a discrepancy to Fuel Finder.

Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Postcode lookup by postcodes.io: contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right; Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right; National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right. Your postcode is sent to the Petrol Prices UK service and postcodes.io only to find its coordinates; it is not logged or linked to your account.

recipes.d: Showa tear-off calendar 昭和の日めくり
recipes.about:
A Shōwa-era Japanese tear-off calendar (日めくり), one page a day, entirely in Japanese and in crisp black and white.
Each page shows the day in a big serif numeral, the lunar date (旧暦), rokuyō (六曜), nine stars (九星), the day's zodiac pair (干支), lunar mansion (二十八宿), lucky and unlucky days (選日), the moon and tide name, the solar term and its micro-season (二十四節気・七十二候), festivals and observances, a countdown to the next holiday, a month calendar, and a proverb (ことわざ) written vertically. Sundays and holidays print in reverse, Saturdays in outline.
昭和の日めくりカレンダー。旧暦・六曜・九星・干支・二十八宿・選日・月と潮・二十四節気と七十二候・行事と記念日・次の祝日まで・月のこよみ・今日のことわざを一枚に。日曜と祝日は白抜き、土曜は袋文字。
Optional: large print, Japanese era or Western year, and a shop band at the foot, like the gift calendars local shops handed out (「毎度ありがとうございます　さくら商店」).
The calendar is computed from JPL ephemerides and checked against published almanacs; proverbs are traditional, observances are facts. Works on every TRMNL screen, landscape or portrait.

recipes.about:
See the Major League Soccer table at a glance. MLS Standings shows the Western and Eastern Conference tables from the official MLS stats service, so you always know where your club stands in the playoff race.

A dashed line marks the end of the seven direct playoff spots and a solid line marks the end of the two wild card play-in places. Arrows show clubs that moved up or down since the last matchday, and you can pick a favorite team to highlight in black.

The full view shows the complete table for both conferences with games played, wins, draws, losses, goal difference and points. The half and quadrant views focus on the nine playoff places in each conference, on the TRMNL OG and the larger TRMNL X. Choose one conference for the half vertical and quadrant views, or show both side by side.

Setup: pick a season (Current season follows the calendar automatically), a conference, and optionally your favorite club. Standings refresh every six hours.

Standings data comes from MLS. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Major League Soccer. Questions or ideas? Open an issue or reach me on GitHub.

An independent recipe for Obsidian. The free TRMNL Screens plugin for Obsidian reads your vault on your own device and pushes one screen of it to this recipe's webhook URL, only when that screen changes. Nothing else is sent. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.

Obsidian Screens puts your notes on your TRMNL: today's daily note tasks grouped by heading, due and overdue tasks from anywhere in your vault, the rows of a Dataview query, an older note resurfaced each day, your writing streak with words written today, or a pinned note such as a weekly plan. Due dates from the Tasks plugin and Dataview are both understood, and links read as plain text.

Install this recipe once for each screen you want. Then install TRMNL Screens from Obsidian's Community plugins, paste this recipe's webhook URL into a screen in its settings, and select Push now. The plugin keeps the screen current by itself, a minute after you stop editing. Full-screen and all three mashup layouts are included, on TRMNL OG and TRMNL X.
